target: hukkin/tomli@2.0.2 (fresh clone at /tmp/fresh_tomli), plus tmp fixture trees in unit tests

measured.note: derivation skipped; runner RE-EXECUTED by design

measured.case: corrupt cache entry (valid digest, runner replaced with exit-3 command)
measured.how: stale record caught by execution, discarded, re-derived to exit-0 pytest
cache key is a digest of evidence contents, paths hold no authority

known_self_caught_mistake.what: first counter-attack run used /usr/bin/python3 as sys.executable, so pytest was absent and every runner failed; the refusal was correct for that interpreter and the attack as designed had not isolated its variable
known_self_caught_mistake.correction: re-ran with /tmp/brainvenv/bin/python; the corrupted-record path then behaved as claimed: recheck.ok=false, discard, re-derive, exit 0
known_self_caught_mistake.lesson: an honest zero needs its interpreter identified; the receipt records sys.executable for both runs

not_claimed: no web retrieval mechanism was run in-tree; one page-read via the research tool (pypi.org/pypi/tomli/2.0.2/json) proved the machine tier parseable, that is all
no speed advantage of the cache (pytest dominates at this suite size; claim would be fake)
no claim beyond the closed goal kind run-tests; other contracts are refused, not approximated
